verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents the full agent-driven loop. The Blaxel skill and official MCP server let an agent create sandboxes from prompts. Each sandbox exposes a built-in MCP server and SDK for running processes, reading files and streaming output logs. Archive and expiration policies (auto-delete after inactivity or TTL) cover teardown without a human. missing for 10: an explicit agent-invoked sandbox delete call (teardown is evidenced only via archive and auto-expiration), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end loop.
